signals.label: Lifetime definition
signals.finding: "Lifetime" means the product's lifetime, not yours.

evidence.quote: The Lifetime Deal guarantees access to monthly credits for the lifetime of the product, defined as long as the service remains actively maintained and available.

signals.label: Hidden caps
signals.finding: The deal says "unlimited", but the vendor's own pages meter usage.

evidence.quote: AvoMap reserves the right to impose reasonable use limits to prevent abuse.
Lifetime Deal (LTD) customers receive 6 video credits per month as part of their one-time purchase.

signals.label: Tier trap
signals.finding: The cheapest tier is a usable slice of the product.

signals.label: Discount size
signals.finding: $59 vs a stated $216 regular price (73% off).

signals.label: One-sided change clauses
signals.finding: The terms let the vendor change features or pricing at any time.

evidence.quote: AvoMap may modify, suspend, or discontinue all or part of the Service at any time without prior notice.
We reserve the right to update these Terms at any time.

claims.text: If plan name changes, deal maps to new plan name with all updates

quote.text: If Plan name changes, deal will be mapped to the new Plan name with all accompanying updates

claims.text: Codes must be redeemed within 60 days of purchase

quote.text: You must redeem your code(s) within 60 days of purchase

claims.text: Each additional code adds 6 monthly credits

quote.text: Each additional code = 6 additional monthly credits

claims.text: AvoMap transforms adventures into animated 3D videos

quote.text: AvoMap is an online tool that allows users to transform their adventures and events into animated 3D videos.

claims.text: Route maps can be customized and exported as high-quality videos

quote.text: It enables the creation of route maps by uploading GPX or KML files or manually designing custom routes, which can then be customized and exported as high-quality videos.

claims.text: AvoMap is fully optimized for mobile devices

quote.text: Yes, AvoMap is fully optimized for mobile devices.

claims.text: Create videos from phone without app installation

quote.text: You can convert files and create 3D videos directly from your phone or tablet using any modern mobile browser without the need for app installation.

claims.text: AvoMap is browser-based with no download required

quote.text: AvoMap is a completely browser-based tool, allowing you to convert files and create videos instantly without downloading or setting up any software.

claims.text: Each video export costs 1 Render Credit

quote.text: Each export and rendering of your video will cost 1 Render Credit.

claims.text: AvoMap uses pay-per-use with no subscriptions or hidden fees

quote.text: AvoMap operates on a pay-per-use model without monthly subscriptions or hidden fees.

claims.text: Conversions happen in browser and files are never uploaded

quote.text: All conversions happen entirely in your browser—your files are never uploaded, stored, or shared with any server.

claims.text: Most videos render within a few minutes

quote.text: Most videos are ready within a few minutes.

finePrint.summary: A lifetime deal lasts only as long as AvoMap itself operates and can be ended at any time.

quote.text: “Lifetime” refers to the operational lifetime of the AvoMap platform. AvoMap reserves the right to discontinue the Service at any time, with or without notice.

finePrint.summary: Monthly lifetime credits are promised only while the service stays actively maintained and available.

quote.text: The Lifetime Deal guarantees access to monthly credits for the lifetime of the product, defined as long as the service remains actively maintained and available.

finePrint.summary: AvoMap can impose reasonable use limits and bans automated or bulk generation unless allowed.

quote.text: AvoMap reserves the right to impose reasonable use limits to prevent abuse.

finePrint.summary: The lifetime deal provides a fixed allowance of 6 video credits per month.

quote.text: Lifetime Deal (LTD) customers receive 6 video credits per month as part of their one-time purchase.

finePrint.summary: Unused lifetime credits roll over but you can never hold more than 150 credits at once.

quote.text: Unused credits automatically roll over to the following months, up to a maximum of 150 credits at any given time.

finePrint.summary: Lifetime-deal purchases are final with no refund except what the law or marketplace requires.

quote.text: LTD purchases are final and non-refundable unless otherwise required by law or agreed upon by the third-party marketplace.

finePrint.summary: Regular credit purchases are also final and non-refundable except where legally required.

quote.text: All credit sales are final and non-refundable unless otherwise required by law or covered by 3.5.

finePrint.summary: AvoMap can change, suspend, or shut down the service at any time without advance notice.

quote.text: AvoMap may modify, suspend, or discontinue all or part of the Service at any time without prior notice.

finePrint.summary: AvoMap can update the terms at any time and continued use means you accept them.

quote.text: We reserve the right to update these Terms at any time.

finePrint.summary: Features can be modified, updated, or removed at any time without prior notice.

quote.text: AvoMap reserves the right to modify, update, or discontinue features or functionality of the Service at any time without prior notice.

finePrint.summary: Your account can be suspended or terminated for violating terms or abusing the service.

quote.text: We may suspend or terminate your account if you violate these Terms or abuse the Service.

finePrint.summary: Lifetime accounts can be suspended or terminated for violations or exceeding fair use.

quote.text: AvoMap may suspend or terminate access to LTD accounts that violate these Terms or exceed fair usage.

finePrint.summary: If your account is terminated or suspended, you lose access and any remaining credits.

quote.text: Upon termination or suspension of your account, your access to the Service and any remaining credits will be revoked.

finePrint.summary: Normally each exported video costs credits, with extras like 4K or logo removal costing more.

quote.text: Each export costs render credits: a 1080p video is 1 credit, and 4K, logo removal or ten or more custom symbols add 1 credit each.

finePrint.summary: Regular buyers purchase one-time credit packs with no subscription or renewal.

quote.text: You buy credits once and spend them when you render a video.

finePrint.summary: The editor and preview are free with all features unlocked, so you only pay to export.

quote.text: The editor is free and every feature is unlocked, including the full 3D preview.

finePrint.summary: Generated videos are stored only 14 days, so you must download them yourself.

quote.text: AvoMap stores videos generated through the Service on our web servers for a period of 14 days from the date of creation.

finePrint.summary: Regular purchased credits expire 12 months after purchase and cannot be refunded.

quote.text: Credits are valid for 12 months from the date of purchase.

trials.claim: Each additional code adds 6 monthly credits
trials.claimQuote: Each additional code = 6 additional monthly credits
trials.reasoning: The terms only say LTD customers receive 6 credits per month for a one-time purchase; they do not say each additional code adds another 6. The 150-credit rollover cap also does not prove or disprove stacking per code.

exhibits.quote: Lifetime Deal (LTD) customers receive 6 video credits per month as part of their one-time purchase.
exhibits.argument: Terms grant a flat 6 credits per month, not 6 additional credits per additional code stacked.

exhibits.quote: Unused credits automatically roll over to the following months, up to a maximum of 150 credits at any given time.
exhibits.argument: Even if credits accumulate, stacking is capped at 150 so additional codes cannot add credits indefinitely.

exhibits.quote: Lifetime Deal (LTD) customers receive 6 video credits per month as part of their one-time purchase.
exhibits.argument: The terms confirm LTD customers receive 6 video credits per month.

trials.claim: Each video export costs 1 Render Credit
trials.claimQuote: Each export and rendering of your video will cost 1 Render Credit.
trials.reasoning: The vendor says a 1080p export is 1 credit, but 4K, logo removal, or ten or more custom symbols each add 1 credit. A buyer also reported extra credits for branding removal, so not every export costs just 1 credit.

exhibits.quote: Previewing is free. Each export costs render credits: a 1080p video is 1 credit, and 4K, logo removal or ten or more custom symbols add 1 credit each.
exhibits.argument: Vendor admits an export can cost more than 1 credit when 4K, logo removal or symbols are used.

exhibits.quote: I eagerly purchased this deal, but I ended up requesting a refund upon discovering that removing branding or adding a custom logo would cost me two extra credits.
exhibits.argument: Buyer reports branding removal costs two extra credits, contradicting the 1-credit-per-export claim.

exhibits.quote: Previewing is free. Each export costs render credits: a 1080p video is 1 credit, and 4K, logo removal or ten or more custom symbols add 1 credit each.
exhibits.argument: The vendor states each 1080p export costs 1 credit.

trials.claim: AvoMap uses pay-per-use with no subscriptions or hidden fees
trials.claimQuote: AvoMap operates on a pay-per-use model without monthly subscriptions or hidden fees.
trials.reasoning: The vendor confirms there is no monthly plan, credits are bought once and spent when rendering, and nothing renews. Credit expiry and non-refundability in the terms do not show a subscription or a hidden fee being charged.

exhibits.quote: Credits are valid for 12 months from the date of purchase.
exhibits.argument: Credits expire after 12 months, which undermines pay-per-use with no hidden fees.

exhibits.quote: All credit sales are final and non-refundable unless otherwise required by law or covered by 3.5.
exhibits.argument: Non-refundable expiring credits are a hidden limitation on the claimed no-fee pay-per-use model.

exhibits.quote: No. AvoMap has no monthly plan. You buy credits once and spend them when you render a video. Nothing renews and there are no hidden fees.
exhibits.argument: The vendor confirms no monthly plan and no hidden fees with one-time credit purchases.

trials.claim: AvoMap transforms adventures into animated 3D videos
trials.claimQuote: AvoMap is an online tool that allows users to transform their adventures and events into animated 3D videos.
trials.reasoning: The vendor describes turning GPX, FIT, KML, Strava activities, or hand-drawn routes into animated 3D map videos. Its headline likewise promises transforming adventures and events into animated videos.

exhibits.quote: AvoMap is a route video maker that runs in your browser. It turns GPX, FIT and KML files, Strava activities, or routes you draw by hand into animated 3D map videos.
exhibits.argument: The vendor describes turning routes and activities into animated 3D map videos.

exhibits.quote: Transform your adventures and events into animated videos in minutes
exhibits.argument: The vendor headline promises transforming adventures and events into animated videos.

trials.claim: Route maps can be customized and exported as high-quality videos
trials.claimQuote: It enables the creation of route maps by uploading GPX or KML files or manually designing custom routes, which can then be customized and exported as high-quality videos.
trials.reasoning: The vendor lists extensive customization with map styles, symbols, colors, and camera movement, and confirms MP4 exports at 1080p Full HD or 4K. An extra charge for 4K and one iPhone download complaint do not negate customization or high-quality export.

exhibits.quote: Videos render as MP4 at 60 frames per second in 1080p Full HD, or in 4K Ultra HD for one extra credit.
exhibits.argument: High-quality 4K export is not included but costs an extra credit.

exhibits.quote: I am unable to download the videos using and iPhone, and this request me to get on my pc to download the video and transfer it to my iPhone for editing.
exhibits.argument: Buyer reports videos cannot be downloaded on iPhone, undermining easy export claim.

exhibits.quote: With 7 map styles in 4 light presets, over 100 symbol presets, 22 ready-to-use colors, and lots of ways to move the camera around, you can make your own video look just the way you want.
exhibits.argument: The vendor describes extensive customization options for the video look.

exhibits.quote: Videos render as MP4 at 60 frames per second in 1080p Full HD, or in 4K Ultra HD for one extra credit.
exhibits.argument: The vendor confirms exports as high-quality 1080p and 4K videos.

trials.claim: AvoMap is fully optimized for mobile devices
trials.claimQuote: Yes, AvoMap is fully optimized for mobile devices.
trials.reasoning: Buyers report editing progress resets on iPhone and that videos cannot be downloaded on iPhone, requiring a PC instead. That directly conflicts with being fully optimized for mobile devices.

exhibits.quote: Mostly easy to work with on iPhone. the editing progress tends to reset.
exhibits.argument: Buyer reports editing resets on iPhone, contradicting fully optimized for mobile.

exhibits.quote: I am unable to download the videos using and iPhone, and this request me to get on my pc to download the video and transfer it to my iPhone for editing.
exhibits.argument: Buyer cannot download videos on iPhone and must use PC, contradicting full mobile optimization.
